# package sparkplugb

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/sparkplugb"
```

Package sparkplugb fingerprints Sparkplug B infrastructures on an MQTT broker: host applications and edge nodes that use the spBv1.0 topic namespace.

Sparkplug B refines MQTT: the fingerprinter connects like the MQTT one (MQTT 3.1.1, clean session, a random client identifier, no will, no credentials) and subscribes, at QoS 0, to the host application STATE topics of Sparkplug 3.0 (spBv1.0/STATE/+, retained) and 2.x (STATE/+), and to the node and device message topics (spBv1.0/+/+/+ and spBv1.0/+/+/+/+: births, deaths, data and commands). It listens for a short bounded window, then unsubscribes and disconnects. It never publishes: no NCMD, DCMD, rebirth request or STATE.

A message on an spBv1.0 topic whose payload decodes as a Sparkplug B protobuf Payload with a timestamp, or a retained 3.0 STATE with the JSON {"online": bool, "timestamp": n}, is certain; a 2.x STATE of "ONLINE" or "OFFLINE" is high. Births are not retained, so an edge node is seen only when it publishes during the window: the retained STATE of a host application is the usual evidence.

Subscribing reads application data, so the fingerprinter is read-only. Detection stops at the first certain message; identify mode listens for the whole window and reports the group, edge node, device and host application IDs, the STATE version, and from NBIRTH payloads the bdSeq and the metric count and names (all bounded).

### type Fingerprinter

```go
type Fingerprinter struct {
	// Window is how long to listen after subscribing. Zero means two
	// seconds, capped by the target timeout.
	Window time.Duration
	// MaxMessages bounds the messages read; zero means DefaultMaxMessages.
	MaxMessages int
	// ClientID, when set, replaces the random client identifier.
	ClientID string
}
```

#### func (Fingerprinter) Detect

```go
func (f *Fingerprinter) Detect(ctx context.Context, target core.Target, opts core.Options) (core.Result, error)
```

Detect probes target. Subscribing reads application data, so nothing is sent unless opts allows read-only probes: a direct call with the zero Options (passive only) returns no match without connecting, as the engine would not have run the fingerprinter at all.

### type Payload

```go
type Payload struct {
	// HasTimestamp reports field 1 (timestamp).
	HasTimestamp bool
	// Timestamp is the payload timestamp (milliseconds since the epoch).
	Timestamp uint64
	// HasSeq reports field 3 (seq).
	HasSeq bool
	// Seq is the sequence number.
	Seq uint64
	// Metrics is the number of metrics.
	Metrics int
	// Names are the first MaxNames metric names, sanitised.
	Names []string
	// HasBdSeq reports a bdSeq metric; BdSeq is its value.
	HasBdSeq bool
	BdSeq    uint64
}
```

Payload is what is kept of a Sparkplug B payload.

#### func DecodePayload

```go
func DecodePayload(b []byte) (Payload, error)
```

DecodePayload decodes a Sparkplug B Payload message (timestamp = 1, metrics = 2, seq = 3, uuid = 4, body = 5; extensions are skipped). A known field of the wrong wire type, a malformed field or a metric that does not decode is an error. At most MaxNames names are kept.

}

#### func ParseTopic

```go
func ParseTopic(topic string) (Topic, error)
```

ParseTopic parses spBv1.0/\<group>/\<type>/\<edge>\[/\<device>], spBv1.0/STATE/\<host> and STATE/\<host>. Every ID must be non-empty.
